correctness.rationale: Every step was reconstructed: diameter-three forces all labels >=3 singleton; label two occurs at most twice and only opposite-side leaves; two disjoint all-one broadcast groups cannot occur; all independent dominating sets are the three explicitly listed; two opposite two-leaves cannot anchor all k groups without adjacent one-labeled centers. These force k-color feasibility exactly at a+2 or b+2. Explicit valid partitions attain all upper bounds; k>N is cardinally impossible. Boundary k=1 and a=b=1 are included. The standalone verifier checks 3136 constructions and 58 small exhaustive profiles; these support rather than substitute for proof.

value.rationale: Determines a natural previously unresolved whole-family k-domatic chromatic spectrum for every nondegenerate diameter-three tree, including exact exceptional indices recoverable from pendant degrees. The new invariant is introduced in the source paper; this is structural classification rather than a few trivial parameter substitutions or isolated enumeration, and bridges the prior path case and the larger tree problem.
